scope: Primary documentation, pinned README/license and selected MCOUT source inspection; no builds or hardware/perception performance tests.

sources.title: ArduPilot JSON backend overview
sources.finding: UDP physics-backend interface; not a single-propeller dynamics model.

sources.title: JSON simulation protocol in inspected ArduPilot fork
sources.finding: Binary PWM output; JSON physics-time/IMU/state input; lower-case readme.md.

sources.title: MCOUT implementation and packet documentation
sources.finding: Separate custom binary UART control stream, sequence/timestamp/CRC/flags; not stock SITL servo packet or MAVLink.

sources.title: Official ArduPilot Gazebo plugin
sources.finding: JSON integration, rendering and lockstep; ROS not required for direct plugin/SITL use.

sources.title: MuJoCo fluid-force models
sources.finding: Phenomenological stateless fluid models; proper fluid dynamics beyond scope.

sources.title: Point-LIO
sources.finding: Default point-lio-with-grid-map; author claims4-8kHz/75rad/s under research conditions; requires per-point times/synchronization; Ubuntu20.04/Noetic tested baseline.
sources.license_observation: BSD-style three-clause text in LICENSE; GitHub SPDX detector NOASSERTION.

sources.title: FAST_LIO
sources.finding: LiDAR-inertial baseline; synchronization and point times required.
sources.license_observation: README GPLv2 and GitHub GPL-2.0 metadata.

sources.title: FAST-LIVO2
sources.finding: LiDAR-IMU-camera fusion, calibration and hard-synchronization references.

sources.title: OpenVINS
sources.finding: Visual-inertial estimator; actual ReadMe.md case verified after README.md404.

sources.title: OpenVINS calibration guidance
sources.finding: Timestamp errors degrade dynamic estimation; calibration requires translation and multiple orientation changes.

sources.title: ArduPilot external navigation interface
sources.finding: ODOMETRY preferred; >=4Hz interface minimum; frames, origin, covariance and reset handling.

sources.title: Spinning actuated LiDAR paper
sources.finding: Submitted January2026; arXiv entry reports RA-L acceptance; LM-Calibr/EVA-LIO evaluate actuated sensor systems, not this drone.

sources.title: LM-Calibr/EVA-LIO repository
sources.finding: EVA-LIO Guide and Hardware Design marked TODO despite paper availability claim.

sources.title: rust-mavlink
sources.finding: Typed MAVLink encoding/decoding and transports; custom MCOUT needs a separate parser.

sources.title: MCAP specification
sources.finding: Schemas/channels, sequence, log_time, publish_time; source sensor clock needs explicit payload/metadata handling.

sources.title: Foxglove SDK
sources.finding: C++/Python/Rust MCAP logging and live visualization; MIT SDK.

sources.title: Low-Cost-Mocap
sources.finding: Author calls main tested; no-cv-sfm completely untested; outside-in lab reference, accuracy must be measured.

limitations: No simulator, causal MCOUT bridge or estimator adapter implemented or tested.
Repository README performance claims are author-reported; no guarantee of transfer to this aircraft.
